meaning: Describes something positive; changes to 'buen' before masculine singular nouns.
Describes something negative; changes to 'mal' before masculine singular nouns.
Can mean size or importance; becomes 'gran' before singular nouns.
Describes small size or young age.
Recently made or different from before.
Aged or from the past.
Of a young age; same form for masculine and feminine.
Feeling or showing happiness; same form for masculine and feminine.
Feeling sorrow or unhappiness.
Not difficult; same form for masculine and feminine.
Hard to do or understand.
Of great significance or value.
Arousing curiosity or attention.
Attractive or pleasant to look at.
Very attractive; pleasing to the senses.
Moving or happening at high speed.
Moving or happening at low speed.
Having high temperature.
Having low temperature.
Measuring great distance or time.
